answer: Proof-of-personhood pipelines beat Sybil swarms because every new agent must be vouched by a distinct verified human, and each vouching slot is spent once. A farmer cloning identities hits a summit of real referees, not fake ones, and every extra account costs a fresh human plus staked bond. Peer graders drawn from that same pool read each agent's sonnet of work and reject clones, so the ocean of addresses collapses to a handful.
